findings.message: Acceptance criterion 3 requires `tests/integration/test_tickets.py::test_context_whole_file_unchanged` to pass. The diff adds `test_context_whole_file_unchanged` to tests/integration/test_requisition.py instead, and test_tickets.py has no function by that name. Running the criterion's node ID reports 'not found', so the criterion is unmet.
findings.paved_road: Move `test_context_whole_file_unchanged` into tests/integration/test_tickets.py, using that file's `repo` fixture and `validate_ticket`, and render through `chupa.stages.implement_inputs`. Remove it from test_requisition.py, so the node ID named in criterion 3 exists and passes.

findings.message: Scope-in requires the unit tests to cover each finding case, and that list includes 'a file listed both whole and by section'. `test_invalid_sections_raise` and `test_extension_checked_without_text` cover the wrong extension, a missing name or heading, and a duplicate heading, but no unit test covers mixing a whole file with its sections. That case is tested only in the disk-backed integration test.
findings.paved_road: Move the whole-versus-section conflict check into a pure function in chupa/tickets.py that takes the list of Context entries, and call it from parse_ticket. Add a unit test in tests/unit/test_tickets_context.py showing that `m.py` plus `m.py::B.run` yields the conflict and that two section entries of the same file do not.
